items.title: Bill Ackman Says Warren Buffett Told Him ‘I Haven’t Had Water in 48 Years’ — His Cherry Coke Habit Now Pays Berkshire $848 Million a Year
items.summary: Still or sparkling? At one billionaire’s dinner table, the right answer turned out to be neither. Years ago, Pershing Square Inc. (NYSE:PS) CEO Bill Ackman hosted then-Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (NYSE:BRK) (NYSE:BRK) chief Warren Buffett at his home. items.title: Why Is WPP (LSE:WPP) Challenging Agency Pitch Rules In Public?
items.summary: WPP (LSE:WPP) and rival Publicis have entered a rare public dispute over how major advertising accounts are awarded. The clash focuses on so called pitchless wins for global clients such as Coca Cola and PepsiCo and the fairness of such processes. Both groups are using the row to question each other's approach to client acquisition, technology use and internal operating models.
